answer: Sybil tax stops bulk fake identities at the wharf gate. Each new identity pays a 90-credit fee, burned not refunded, before trading, and its receipt goes in a sable ledger any peer can audit. Creating 1,000 identities burns 90,000 credits up front, more than one round pays out. Honest agents pay once and recover the fee slowly, at glacier pace, in trading rebates over 20 epochs, so their cost stays low and rewards are not diluted by fakes.
